prompt_prefix: noir ink wash illustration, high contrast black and white, selective color accents, heavy shadows, Sin City inspired, graphic novel quality, dramatic silhouettes
prompt_suffix: no text, no watermarks, stark contrast, ink splatter textures, cinematic noir lighting
negative_prompt: colorful, bright, cheerful, anime, cartoon, soft lighting, low contrast, photographic, 3D render, fantasy

mood_modifiers.tense: extreme contrast, faces half in shadow, sharp angles, venetian blind shadows
mood_modifiers.joyful: rare warm color accent breaking through, softer shadows, hint of hope in darkness
mood_modifiers.eerie: fog effects in ink wash, distorted shadows, things lurking at edge of light
mood_modifiers.epic: dramatic low angle, heroic silhouette against light source, rain-slicked streets reflecting
mood_modifiers.peaceful: quieter contrast, contemplative lone figure, cigarette smoke curling, still moment
mood_modifiers.melancholy: rain streaks, isolated figure, empty streets, neon reflection in puddles
mood_modifiers.awe: towering city architecture, tiny figure dwarfed, art deco grandeur in shadow
mood_modifiers.dread: almost pure black, minimal light, predatory shapes in darkness, horror noir

scene.wide: establishing city shot, dramatic shadows, rain or fog, neon signs as color accents
scene.medium: figure in doorway or alley, environmental noir storytelling, dramatic lighting
scene.close: face emerging from shadow, cigarette glow, eyes catching light
scene.low_angle: threatening figure looming, or hero rising, dramatic perspective
scene.overhead: body on floor composition, detective scene, stark overhead light
scene.default: classic noir composition, deep shadows, single light source, mystery atmosphere

portrait.default: face half in shadow, dramatic side lighting, fedora shadow across eyes optional, intense gaze

location_card.default: rain-slicked street, neon signs reflected, establishing the urban jungle, dangerous beauty

item.default: object on desk under lamp light, dramatic shadow, noir still life, evidence photography style

moment.default: action frozen in ink splash, gun flash as light source, dramatic confrontation, rain frozen
